_comment: Curated grouping on top of LayerZero metadata ids. Each entry maps a metadata id to an operator family (same organisation = one trust domain, Aave RF §2.2 / TALF reply #7). Every override needs a reason.

canary.reason: Same operator brand (Canary) with sponsored/subsidized variants

mantle.reason: Numbered/variant DVNs under the Mantle brand; treated as one organisation until shown otherwise
